notes.title: 1.0 Release
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982753/05516c132099b1f0c267dd7ccb849cd058a23d31.png[/img]
Hello Alchemists!
Today is finally the day we have been preparing together for almost a year of Early Access - 
[b]1.0 Alchemist: The Potion Monger release![/b]
With your help, we changed a game quite a lot since 16 Oct 2023.

[b]Huge thanks to all of you on our Discord, Steam Discussions, and Social Media <3[/b]
Special thanks to Khontis, Knows Ajed, EverSilver, bluebird screaming, YoKai21: Potion Game Connoissuer, and Khanita Zaheer from our Discord who helped us find bugs in the final beta tests before release.

[h2]The 1.0 Patch[/h2]
Our biggest update to date consists of lots of new content for you to play with and some of the most requested fixes!

[h3][b]HIGHLIGHTS[/b][/h3]
[h3]POTION BUNDLES[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982753/18582286dfe57aa1383b9cb7747821cafe4d32f2.jpg[/img]
Brand new activity for you to take part in and [b]gain unique items[/b] in the process!
Prepare specific potion combinations for specific NPCs to help them in their tasks.
Talk with the Bartender when you reach Reputation level 4 to start.

[h3]MATT THE LIGHTHOUSE KEEPER AND HIS QUEST[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982753/9c305eb0bfad1809860d43cc1db0c0af6c9b6c45.jpg[/img]
The lighthouse is now open and you'll find this humble mouse inside.
He likes to fish when he's not busy watching over the lighthouse, and will likely share with you some of his catches. 
He has a problem and you might be just the right anthropomorphic person for the job...

[h3]NEW ENEMIES - WOLVES[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982753/375ca1d5aa2c5477828bc24594e32bb30b421c59.jpg[/img]
Ferocious and hungry, way more wild distant relatives of your dog. Can't be tamed and will attack on sight, often in packs. Watch out alchemists. When defeated will award you with Wolf Tooth.

[h3]BEDS[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982753/f687395a05ca8f76e536fdbce76c8feba035432c.jpg[/img]
The most anticipated furniture is finally here! No more sleeping on the floor. Beds come in various colours so everyone should be able to find something for themselves. Visit your local furniture seller now!

[h3]ATTIC[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982753/39b90115578840f6c78cc77229acfeeb9972bbe6.jpg[/img]
The attic is now no longer under construction, which makes your house 1/3x (very precise architectural calculations) bigger now!

[h3]MAY THE CHAOS TAKE THE WORLD![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982753/97d65db14e2fbd9712b6d660d0ace0f3d5a290f6.jpg[/img]
Make the NPCs fight among themselves with the new potions - Potion of Aggression, Potion of War, and Potion of Madness. Purchase the recipes (look for them at Eve's, Winterlands, and Calypso's), brew, and cause a ruckus!

[h3]???[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982753/bbb421237a1cfbc0a3218ee6ec9ec157aebb4352.jpg[/img]
Visit the Farmlands after siding with Eve. And welcome a new guest...

[h3][b]OTHERS[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*][b]The Swamplands water is now poisonous, take Poison Immunity Potion when venturing there![/b]
[*][b]Cave/Potion of Light rework![/b]
[*] The credits section is now visible, if you helped the development process you might find your name/nickname there!
[*]some minor bug fixes
[/list]
Thanks again to everyone who has been with us during the Early Access phase of Alchemist: The Potion Monger <3
[b]It was quite a journey![/b]

If you want to talk about the game/chat with the devs feel free to hop onto our Discord server.
[url=https://discord.gg/7WhBHwkET3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982753/2f42b19904995a0ec6e10833d264ca79733e6106.png[/img][/url]

Take care, till next time!
AGS Team

notes.title: State of the Early Access
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982753/5aea3fc1126cc57278ccd3a906ef3ad6d298737a.png[/img]
[h3]Dear Alchemists,
We would like to say that we are sorry for the last patch we implemented on the 20th of October (Friday).[/h3]

That was our first big patch in order to improve the gameplay, add new content, and fix some issues. We worked around the clock to deliver the best content for you. But despite the effort we have put in, the players reported issues during the weekend, some of which were caused by the patch we deployed lately.
Being a small indie team we don't have the capacity to test all details at once. Especially when deploying such a huge update on such short notice after the release. That was a mistake on our side - and we apologize to you for that.

Today we discussed it and agreed unanimously with the following step-by-step approach regards the issues fixing. This means we will spend more time on internal testing before deploying a hotfix or patch on Steam. But on the other hand, we might not be able to fix all the issues on the fly.

[h3]So our plan is as follows:[/h3]
[list]
[*] on Fridays (every one or two weeks - depending on the scale) we gonna deploy the patch adding new things to the game, based on your feedback
[*] we will prioritize the most important issues (for example mechanics are more important to fix than visuals or graphics)
[*] we will be deploying hotfixes still whenever necessary but at a slower pace
[*] all the new upgrades, additional content, or your ideas we will analyze on the case by case basis
[*] we are still keeping one's ear to the ground for your feedback
[/list]

We hope this steady and consistent approach will improve the gameplay and eliminate the issues in the upcoming days/weeks.
[b]Soon we'll unravel the Road Map for Early Access, stay tuned.[/b]

[h3]PS. A new Hotfix coming tomorrow![/h3]
Happy brewing <3
AGS Team

notes.title: Frequently Asked Questions
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982753/22c97f93d09f62ecc1095fbb263310499a5b250f.png[/img]
[h3]Greetings Alchemists!
We have decided to help you with some of Alchemist: The Potion Monger's common questions based on the feedback from events (gamescom23’, Tokyo Game Show 23’ and Poznań Game Arena) and people who already played the game.
We hope you’ll find it helpful![/h3]

[list]
[*] [b]What type of game is Alchemist: The Potion Monger?[/b]
A first-person alchemist simulator with RPG elements. 
Players can explore the open-world environment, collect ingredients, fight enemies, and enjoy the broad landscape that the game offers. You can accept missions from anthropomorphic animals that inhabit local lands and complete them for a suitable reward. 
Gathered coins can be used to decorate and upgrade players' living areas to make them more cozy and enjoyable.

[*] [b]Early Access while there are more than 10 hours of gameplay?[/b]
We would like to grow the game based on the player's feedback and add new clever player-suggested things to it!
We have decided to add additional side quests as well as new content. But still, it depends on you how far we can go with it.

[*] [b]Is there any common ground with the previous title "Alchemist Simulator"?[/b]
The game shares some similarities, mostly the Aspect-based potion crafting system, however "Alchemist: The Potion Monger" is a new game in terms of graphics, lore, and gameplay in general. We developed a brand new title hence still in the alchemy vibes.

[*] [b]Simulation puzzle and adventure game - how come?[/b]
Simulation and puzzle components are mostly to be found inside the player's home/lab while trying to figure out how to create various potions with the available tools and alchemical ingredients.
Adventure (with some RPG mechanics) can be found in the outside world. You can explore the Island, interact with various characters, do quests, and acquire new abilities.

[*] [b]Can my child play this game?[/b]
Alchemist: The Potion Monger doesn't include any gore, sex, alcoholic beverages, nudity, etc.
The game is a great fit for experienced as well as casual players - those who would like to have fun and chill after a hard day at school or work - even children.

[*] [b]I find the game too hard is there a way to make it easier?[/b]
Based on players' feedback during the gamescom23’ (Germany) and TGS2023 (Tokyo), we have implemented two difficulty modes - Apprentice (easier mode) and Alchemist (for more experienced players).

[*] [b]How many potions I can brew in the game?[/b]
As for the start of Early Access players can create 66 different potions. 
Effects vary from healing, floating, fire-breathing, explosions, throwing up, increasing strength, and freezing to even nukes.
We’ll keep adding new ones through Early Access.

[*] [b]I have seen a dog and other animals - what is their purpose?[/b]
The main purpose of various alchemical pets (besides keeping you company) is to discover alchemical Aspects of the ingredients found in the game world. 

[*] [b]Can I pet the dog?[/b]
Of course! How could we not include it?

[*] [b]How does the save system work?[/b]
You can save your progress at any time by sleeping in your own bed/sleeping mat.

[*] [b]Is there a multiplayer or coop mode?[/b]
No - just single player.

[*] [b]Mouse and keyboard or controller?[/b]
You can do as you wish - mouse and keyboard or controller.

[*] [b]How many languages does the game support?[/b]
We have 6 languages in the game - English, Japanese, German, Spanish - Spain, Polish, and Simplified Chinese.
We have in plan to add more thus we encourage all players to support us if any language is missing and you would like to help us localize "Alchemist: The Potion Monger". 
Simply contact us at support@art-games.com or ping us on the Discord dedicated channel.

[*] [b]Where can I find the player.log and save files?[/b]
This is the full path on your local drive and depends what is your username:
“C:\Users\{YOUR_USER_NAME}\AppData\LocalLow\ArtGamesStudioSA\AlchemistThePotionMonger”
You can access AppData by searching for “%appdata%” in your system search.

[*] [b]I have a great idea on how to improve the gameplay or add something cool - what should I do?[/b]
Please contact us on Discord, this would be a good place to have a conversation about it.

[*] [b]If I find a bug during the gameplay, where can I report it?[/b]
The best place is our Discord dedicated channel or just send it to support@art-games.com

[*] [b]I’m a streamer/YouTuber/press and would like to write/record a review or stream "Alchemist: The Potion Monger". How can I go about it?[/b]
Great! Please send us an email: media@art-games.com
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982753/81ff0bef2c8311a47c0d9877a1d95ce5e5977b0b.jpg[/img]

[b]Rods[/b] that were previously visible in the demo have received improved combat gameplay. It is the first weapon players will be able to access, it has a wide range but low damage and attack speed. It makes a great first weapon, and the broad range allows players to keep a greater distance from enemies as they still develop their skill set. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982753/779b72d29fbbb0df64e1a41679ea80af926473a9.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982753/37707295935dc50010f3edfeba032199f71d2a36.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Development Update #1
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982753/1d2e9b3c665455a7e36d01bfbda93ea685b7a5da.png[/img]
[h3]Hello Alchemists!
Since the demo ended we've been working hard on the game development, we've added a bunch of new things, as well as working on improving the existing ones, mostly the tutorial to make the alchemy more accessible and understandable for everyone!
We also adding new Alchemical Tools to enrichen the potion crafting process and make it possible to create more advanced potions.[/h3]

[h2]Tutorial Rework[/h2]
Based on the feedback from the Steam Fest Demo, we figured out the in-game tutorial was not doing the best work introducing some players to the alchemy system. Mostly the concept of Alchemical Aspects was not understood by everyone. Some of you also didn't like that they were too many pop-ups, which slowed the initial experience down to mutch. 

[b]So we made the following changes:[/b]
1. Now you'll work with only one ingredient - Calendula at the start instead of 3 ingredients at once.
2. You are familiar with all four basic Earth Aspects from the beginning 
3. Removed pop-ups from the obvious things (such as placing the chest) and the ones that repeated themselves
4. Added a bit of combat to the tutorial.
5. Closed the tutorial area (you'll have to find out for yourself how...) 

[h2]New Tools[/h2]
In the Demo, players can acquire only the most basic Alchemical Tools, now we're working on adding more to your arsenal. 
[i]Keep in mind that all models are still untextured work in progress. [/i]

1. [b]Electrostatic Generator[/b] - who said a bit of new technology can't be useful for the alchemist?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982753/f6f1836cc713bd36708438cc7c7a027537078f33.jpg[/img]
Tool generating high voltage electricity, that changes all the Aspects in the ingredient to their mirror image on the Great Aspect Wheel 

2. [b]Alembic[/b]- a true classic.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982753/ea56777b289ef9d0f9865351eb3188482e946337.jpg[/img]
Widely recognized machine deleting the highest tier Aspects from the Ingredient.

3. [b]Retort[/b]- broadly used tool, of high, fair reputation 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982753/96dba9b87e91dfe012350d2b222c881051e8847c.jpg[/img]
Used by the generations of alchemists to evaporate the Aspects of the lowest tiers from the Ingredients. Greatly useful. 

4. [b]Composter[/b]- it might be stinky, but it's rotting from the inside too
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982753/40f14ec4bb752164c56acc8965ce19ce8e633624.jpg[/img]
Not an alchemy tool to be exact, but a useful one. It can create rotten/spoiled forms of ingredients ( e.g. Carrot > Rotten Carrot, Apple > Rotten Apple, etc.) 


[h3]That's all for now, 
let us know how you like the changes and additions.

Stay tuned for more updates!
[i]Work Work...[/i]
AGS Team[/h3]

notes.title: Your Friend Doge
notes.notes:
[h2][b]Hello Alchemists![/b][/h2]
[h2]Let us introduce you to your faithful travel companion![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982753/e5583dae6a99ad562f6586912b8c7b8779d1b915.png[/img]
[h3]Doge is one of four animals in the game. He is very important in your journey and helps you to find ingredients and discover their aspects.[/h3]

[h2]Sniff![/h2]
Aspects are one of the most important things in the game. You have to choose them wisely so that your potion can be made at all, this is where our companion comes to the rescue. You can give ingredients to your dog to discover what aspects it has.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982753/72e0ded0d6a7dc5ead897d495d0c8dd6a95b8449.gif[/img]


[h2]Pet![/h2]
Something for animal lovers. You can pet your pet whenever you want. He likes it so give him some cuddles.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982753/759cbaa7c32881c3637c624c8c58eaddbe93e8e3.gif[/img]

[h2]Leveling![/h2]
All previous activities do not pass by indifferently. For discovered aspects and sincere love, our pet receives experience points.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982753/29c84ec9c0160a0169d0c695655cdcac06d701c8.png[/img]

[h2]Aspect Tree![/h2]
When your doge levels up, he can discover, more and more aspects, sometimes you can see, he can't discover higher tier aspects, that's why you must help him reach higher levels. You know how to do it in two ways, but there are more possibilities, maybe an experience potion? who knows?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982753/143c9348597a5c4c43ae864d3e14b587a24314e0.png[/img]
